Welcome to hearme 🎙️

Everything runs locally — your voice never leaves this Mac. Three macOS permissions are needed. During development they go to your terminal app; the bundled app prompts on its own.

Microphone
to hear you (prompted on first dictation)
Accessibility
to type text into the focused app
Input Monitoring
to detect the dictation hotkey

Then try it: click into any text field, hold Right Option, speak, release. Double-tap to lock for longer dictation. Hold Shift + Right Option for polish mode.
